title: BSA Gold Star 650 Modern Classic (Custom Edition)
description: Representing BSA Motorcycles India's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the BSA Motorcycles India BSA Gold Star 650 Modern Classic (Custom Edition) is delivers authentic heritage styling paired with modern highway mile-munching comfort. A 650cc powerplant pumps out 89 HP and 73 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
